stemMarkdown: Two runners start at the same time from the same point on a circular track of length 800 m and run in opposite directions at 10 m/s and 19 m/s. After how many seconds will they first meet? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Running in opposite directions, relative speed $= 10 + 19 = 29$ m/s. They first meet after covering the full circumference between them: time $= \dfrac{800}{29} = 27.59$ s.
